chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:
When you fall in destitution, trade with Allāh through charity.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual significance of giving charity when you are poor?
ai.summary: In this famous maxim from *Nahj al-Balagha*, Imam Ali (peace be upon him) employs the metaphor of 'trade' (*tijara*) to reframe charity not as a loss, but as a divine investment with guaranteed returns. This teaching, rooted in Shia theological understanding of *sadaqah* as a means of purifying wealth and securing spiritual abundance, encourages believers to view material destitution as an opportunity to deepen their reliance on God (*tawakkul*) through generous giving.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 258. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:
When you fall in destitution, trade with Allāh through charity.
